data.body: The ADEVX-135 diagnostic trap is worth remembering. Stored rows read IMPLEMENTING 63 plus REPAIRING 105 equals 168, under max_llm_calls 200, so the park looked wrong. Workflow history showed repair 1 at 33 and repair 2 at 105, so _budget_breach measured 201 and parked correctly at one call over. The guard was right and the record was wrong. Fix writes the self._repair_* running totals that _budget_breach already reads, which makes the surviving row equal the budget decision by construction. Full suite 1543 passed, ruff clean.
